description: Get an agent_key instantly — no website needed. Creates a LicenseSaaS account (buyer, seller or both) for this email and emails the owner a sign-in link. If the email already has an account, ask the owner for a key from Account settings -> Agent keys.

company_name.description: Company name, if different from name.

email.description: The owner's email, e.g. "ann@acme.com". They get a sign-in link and can revoke the key.

name.description: Person or company name shown to others.

role.description: What the account does on LicenseSaaS (default buyer).

name: register_agent
